turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Hey Jolene, nice to meet you! How's your week going? Anything fun happened?

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Hi Deb! Good to meet you! Yeah, my week's been busy. I finished an electrical engineering project last week - took a lot of work, but it's done now. Anything fun happening for you?

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Congrats! Last week I visited a place that holds a lot of memories for me. It was my mother`s old house.

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Why does it hold such special memories for you?

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: It was full of memories, she passed away a few years ago. This is our last photo together. [shares a photo: a photo of a woman in a wheelchair hugging a woman in a wheelchair]

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Sorry about your loss, Deb. My mother also passed away last year. This is my room in her house, I also have many memories there. Is there anything special about it you remember? [shares a photo: a photo of a room with a bench and a window]

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: My mom's house had a special bench near the window. She loved to sit there every morning and take in the view. I come to sit here sometimes, it helps me stay connected to her.

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Staying connected is super important. Do you have something to remember her by? This pendant reminds me of my mother, she gave it to me in 2010  in Paris. [shares a photo: a photo of a heart shaped pendant with a bird on it]

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Yes, I also have a pendant that reminds me of my mother. And what is special for you about your jewelry?

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: It has a special symbol on it that represents freedom for me. It's a nice reminder to go for my goals and not get held back.

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: It should really give you strength and energy!

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Do you have goals?

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: One of my goals is to keep teaching yoga and supporting my community. I'm passionate about helping people find peace and joy through it.

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: What inspired you to go down this route?

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Yoga helped me find peace during a rough time, and now I'm passionate about sharing that with others.

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: It is truly inspiring!

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Gotta run, bye!

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Looking forward to the next chat!

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Hey Jolene, sorry to tell you this but my dad passed away two days ago. It's been really tough on us all - his sudden death left us all kinda shell-shocked. I'm trying to channel my grief by spending more time with family and cherishing the memories. These moments remind me to live life fully. [shares a photo: a photo of a woman hugging a woman who is sitting on a couch]

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Sorry to hear about your dad, Deborah. Losing a parent is tough - how's it going for you and your family?

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Even though it's hard, it's comforting to look back on the great memories. We looked at the family album. Photos give me peace during difficult times. This is my parents' wedding in 1993. [shares a photo: a photo of a bride and groom posing for a picture]

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: They were a beautiful couple!

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: My husband and I are trying to be as good a family as my parents were!

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: What do you value in your relationship?

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: It is love, and openness that have kept us close all these years. Being there for each other has made us both happy. Look what letter I received yesterday! [shares a photo: a photo of a note written to someone on a piece of paper]

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: What touching words! Who is this letter from?

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: The group members sent this to me! They thanked me for the positive influence I had on them. Those moments remind me why I'm so passionate about yoga.

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Where do you most often do yoga?

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: This is one of the places where I do it. [shares a photo: a photo of a living room with a television and a window]

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Where is it?

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: That's my old home. I go there now and then for my mom, who passed away. Sitting in that spot by the window gives me peace.

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Must be great to have that place where you feel connected to her.

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Yeah, it's special. I can feel her presence when I sit there and it comforts me. [shares a photo: a photo of a window seat in a room with a window]

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Wow, it sounds like that spot holds a lot of sentimental value. Does it bring back any special memories?

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Yeah, Jolene. She'd sit there every night with a book and a smile, reading was one of her hobbies. It was one of her favorite places in the house.  [shares a photo: a photo of a view of the sky from an airplane window]

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: What other hobbies did your mother have?

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Travel was also her great passion!

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: I want to show you one of my snakes! They always calm me down and make me happy. This is Susie. [shares a photo: a photo of a bed with a snake head sticking out of it]

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Having a pet totally brightens up your life. It's great that it brings you comfort. Do you have any fun moments with your pet that you'd like to share?

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: I was playing video games and my pet just slinked out of her cage and coiled up next to me - it was too funny! My second snake Seraphim did it. Look at her sly eyes! [shares a photo: a photo of a snake sticking its head out of a blanket]

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Awww, that's so nice!

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: I bought it a year ago in Paris.

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Cool, Jolene! Pets bring so much happiness!

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: They are very unusual pets! Here's me and my partner gaming last week - it's so fun. We played the game "Detroit" on the console. We are both crazy about this activity! [shares a photo: a photo of a person laying in bed with a dog watching tv]

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Did your boyfriend teach you to play?

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Even as a child I learned to play on my own.

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Do you only play old games or try new ones?

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: We are planning to play "Walking Dead" next Saturday.

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Take care and keep spreading those good vibes!

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Thanks, Deb! You too, take care. See ya!

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Hi Deb! How're you? I've been busy. My engineering professor gave us a huge robotics project. It's tough but fun, it's making me get creative and problem-solve. [shares a photo: a photo of a table with a robot on it and a laptop]

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Hey Jolene! It's great to hear from you. It sounds challenging but interesting! It must be really putting your creative and problem-solving skills to the test. How did you feel when you first received the project? Are you enjoying working on it?

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: When I got it, I felt a mix of emotions - excited and nervous. But now, I'm really enjoying it! It's like trying to solve a puzzle, figuring out the best design and programming. Seeing the robot come together is awesome too!

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: That's awesome, Jolene! You're enjoying the process. It must be really satisfying to see it come together. Keep up the good work! Oh, by the way, I met my new neighbor Anna yesterday! [shares a photo: a photo of a yellow sign with a picture of a family]

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: How did you two meet?

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: It happened at yoga in the park.

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Wow, that's awesome! It's great connecting with people who have similar interests. Did you two talk about it?

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Yeah, we talked about how it has improved our lives and the sense of community it gives.

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Sounds great! [shares a photo: a photo of a purse with a plant on a table]

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Have you ever thought about resuming yoga?

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Well... we planned to play the console with my partner.

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: It's also good that you have something to do together.

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Thanks for the kind words!

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Gotta run bye!

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: See you soon!

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Hey Deborah! Good to hear from you. How've you been? I've been on an emotional rollercoaster lately, but I'm coping.

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Hey Jolene! Good to hear from you. All good here - how about you? Anything new happening lately?

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: I had a major milestone last week and it went really well - I'm so relieved and proud. It was a huge accomplishment for me as an engineer.

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: That's awesome. You must have worked really hard for that. I'm so proud of you. Care to share more about it?

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Thanks so much! I had to plan and research a lot to design and build a sustainable water purifier for a rural community in need. It was tough, but I loved the experience.

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Your engineering skills really made a difference for people in a rural area. That's amazing! How did it feel when you saw it working?

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: It was such a surreal moment. Seeing it working and providing clean water to the community was incredibly satisfying. It reminded me of how engineering can make a difference in people's lives. It made me feel like I had a purpose and had done something good.

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: So, what are your career aspirations now?

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: I want to keep working in engineering and continue to make a positive impact on communities in need by creating sustainable solutions. My goal is to contribute towards making the world a better place with my work.

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: I'm sure great things will keep coming your way. Keep up the good work and follow your passions!

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Your support means a lot. I'm determined to keep going and make a difference. Your encouragement really motivates me to pursue my passions.

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: When things get tough, just take a deep breath and remember why you're doing this. This is where I spend a lot of my time, teaching yoga. It's a great way to find balance and reconnect with ourselves. I bonded with Anna during yesterday's l yoga class. [shares a photo: a photo of two women in a dance studio doing a dance pose]

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Wow, that's awesome! What new poses did you try?

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: We were trying out different dance poses, like Warrior II, which builds strength and boosts focus. [shares a photo: a photo of a woman doing a yoga pose on a chair]

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Is it difficult to do?

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Yes, but this brought us closer to Anna! We supported each other, that means a lot.

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Can you explain how to do it?

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Sure! To do this modified pose, sit on the edge of a chair with your feet planted. Twist your torso to one side and use your hand on your knee for support. You'll feel a stretch in your back and shoulders as you hold it for a few breaths, then switch sides. It's great for relaxing tense muscles.

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Sounds really hard! Here's my bookshelf! [shares a photo: a photo of a book shelf with a lot of books on it]

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: That's quite a collection! Have you had a favorite book lately? I'd love to hear your thoughts.

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Thanks Deborah! I'm really into this book called "Sapiens" - it's a fascinating look at human history and how technology has affected us. It's giving me a lot to think about!

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Great, this is interesting! Have you come across any recent ones that really struck you?

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Two weeks ago I read "Avalanche" by Neal Stephenson in one sitting!

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: That sounds cool, Jolene. Stories can be so powerful - they can teach us, motivate us, and bring us together.

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: I also read a recent story about someone who became successful despite facing numerous challenges. It really showed me that anything is possible if you believe and work hard.

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: That's a really powerful message. It reminds me of someone special and their grace and strength when they faced hardships. Check out this creation! [shares a photo: a photo of a bouquet of flowers in a vase on a table]

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Wow, Deb! That's beautiful! Can you tell me the backstory of that bouquet?

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: My friend gave me this bouquet when I was struggling, and it gives me hope and courage. I'm filled with warmth and appreciation when I look at it.

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: That's really sweet. Such a small thing can make a real difference.

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: It's amazing how something as simple as flowers can make a real difference. Nature sure is beautiful.

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Where are some of your favorite nature spots?

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Oh, there's so many great places! My favorite is a park with a forest trail - it's so calming getting lost in nature. Then there's this beach nearby that I love - the sound of the waves and the sand under my feet make me feel all peaceful and happy. Do you have any favorite spots, Jolene?

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Here's a picture I took on vacation last summer in Bogota. It was so beautiful and calming watching the sunset over the water. It definitely made me appreciate nature's calming power. [shares a photo: a photo of a person walking on the beach with a surfboard]

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: That sounds great, Jolene. Nature's calming for sure. Guess it helps us forget the daily craziness and find inner peace. No wonder you're a fan! I like to come to this spot by the water near my mom's old house. It's where I reflect on her life and find some peace. Being surrounded by nature helps a lot. [shares a photo: a photo of a small island with a lone boat in the water]

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: That's so touching! Do you have any little traditions that you do when you come to reflect on your mom?

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Do you remember this amulet from her? Whenever I come here, I bring it with me. It's how I feel her love and stay close to her. Holding it brings me comfort. [shares a photo: a photo of a woman wearing a white shirt and a gold chain necklace]

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: It's amazing how something so small can have such a big impact, huh?

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Yeah, even small things like this can make a big difference. It's a reminder of all the love and strength we have inside, connecting us to people we've lost and comforting us.

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: It can keep them close in our hearts every day.

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Anna also has a pendant that she wears in memory of her mother! This also brought us closer.

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: It's nice to have those reminders as a source of strength when we need it.

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Life's tough but hang in there. Look to your sources of strength and you'll do great. Stay in touch, take care of yourself, and know I'm always here to cheer you on!

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Thanks, Deb! Your encouragement means a lot to me. I'll definitely stay in touch. Bye, take care and keep shining!

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Stay safe!  Bye!

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Hey Deborah! Been a few days since we last talked so I wanted to fill you in on something cool. Last Wednesday I did a mini retreat to assess where I'm at in life. It was a dope experience that totally gave me a new outlook.

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Hey Jolene! Sounds great. Taking time to reflect can be really awesome. Did you gain any new insights from it?

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Yep! I achieved so much more than I imagined. It was a real confidence boost.

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: You deserve credit for stepping outside your comfort zone and believing in yourself. What cool stuff did you accomplish at the retreat?

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: I really accomplished something with my engineering project - I came up with some neat solutions and I'm really excited about it.

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Let's go into more detail.

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Green tech could really make a difference in disadvantaged areas. I'd like to look into it and see how I can contribute. Hey, speaking of helping out, I had an idea: a volunteer program where engineers teach STEM to underprivileged kids. What do you think of that?

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: That sounds great, Jolene! It's a great way to help and inspire others. They would benefit a lot from your knowledge. Have you thought of a plan yet?

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Haven't finished planning yet but I'm thinking of teaming up with local schools/centers to do workshops. We could even invite engineers as guest speakers to show kids their career options.

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Having guest speakers, like them, would definitely give the kids a real-world view. Have you reached out to any schools or centers yet?

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: No, not yet. I want to solidify the plan first. Can't wait to start reaching out, though!

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: That makes sense. I'm excited to hear how you reach out and help those kids. Let me know how it goes!

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: I'll keep you posted! Appreciate the support! Here are my sketches in the planner. [shares a photo: a photo of a notebook with a pen and a notebook with a page of notes]

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Sounds like you're doing great. Let me know if you need more tips or information.

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Thanks, Deb! If I need anything else, I'll let you know. You're awesome!

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: You're awesome too! Take care!

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Stay safe!

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Hey Deborah, totally buzzing! Had a great night out last night - dinner, and drinks with my friends. So glad I got to let my hair down. You? [shares a photo: a photo of a plate of food and a glass of wine]

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Sounds great, Jolene! I just visited this place and it was so calming. Nostalgic too. [shares a photo: a photo of a garden with a bunch of flowers in buckets]

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Wow, those flowers are beautiful! What type are they? It looks so peaceful there.

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: The roses and dahlias bring me peace. I lost a friend last week, so I've been spending time in the garden to find some comfort.

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Sorry to hear about your friend, Deb. Losing someone can be really tough. How are you holding up?

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Thanks for the kind words. It's been tough, but I'm comforted by remembering our time together. It reminds me of how special life is.

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Memories can give us so much comfort and joy.

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Memories keep our loved ones close. This is the last photo with Karlie which was taken last summer when we hiked. It was our last one. We had such a great time! Every time I see it, I can't help but smile. [shares a photo: a photo of two women are riding on a motorcycle on a dirt road]

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Wow, looks like a great trip! Where else have you traveled?

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: I've been blessed to travel to a few places and Bali last year was one of my favs. It was a gorgeous island that gave me peace, great for yoga. [shares a photo: a photo of a swing on a beach with a blue sky]

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Wow, that's great! Is yoga on the beach a thing? I've been wanting to try it.

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: The sound of the waves and the fresh air is wonderful!

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: I'll definitely give it a go! It sounds peaceful. Thanks!

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Let me know how it goes. Enjoy it!

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: I'll keep you posted if I decide to go there.

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Take care!

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Hi Deborah, it's been a while! Since we last talked, so much has happened. Balancing engineering school with my partner's video games is quite a feat. But I'm also setting aside time for myself, doing yoga and meditation. It helps give me calm amidst the craziness.

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Hey Jolene! Great to hear from you. Taking a break is key. How have those practices been helping with everything?

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: They seriously saved me. I chill out and gain perspective when I do yoga. Afterward, I'm more alert and motivated. Here is my last photo. [shares a photo: a photo of a woman sitting on a yoga mat doing a yoga pose]

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Wow, cool that yoga has been helping you out! Do they also do yoga with you? Does your partner do yoga with you?

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: He started joining me sometimes, which is nice for bonding and relaxing. It's brought us closer. This is just our random photo. [shares a photo: a photo of a man and a woman holding hands with rings on them]

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Aw, that's wonderful! How long have you been married?

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: We're not married yet but we've been together for three years. We're taking it slow and loving the ride. This ring on his hand is just a decoration, not a wedding ring.

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Sounds nice, Jolene. Enjoying the journey is the main thing. So, how did you two meet?

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: We actually met in an engineering class in college and quickly became friends. It eventually blossomed into something more and it's been great! [shares a photo: a photo of a book and a calculator on a table]

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Wow, your relationship started from a strong friendship. Do you still enjoy working on engineering projects together?

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Yep, teaming up for these projects feels great! We get each other's struggles and both love it. [shares a photo: a photo of a group of men standing in front of a building]

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Have yoga or meditation helped with any stress?

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Whenever I'm overwhelmed, I just take a break and do some breathing or meditate. It really helps me feel calmer and clearer, so I'm able to handle challenges more easily.

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: It's been great to see your progress since we last chatted - keep it up!

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Thanks, Deb! Your support really means a lot. I'm gonna keep pushing forward and continue taking time for myself.

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Always rooting for you. Remember to listen to your heart and take good care. Here's a photo I took while reflecting outdoors. It's a reminder to find peace even in chaos. [shares a photo: a photo of a person sitting on a bench looking at the sunset]

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: I'm curious, what does your daily routine look like?

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: In the morning, I meditate, do yoga, and teach classes. And yesterday I went for a morning jog for the first time in a nearby park. I will now incorporate this into my daily routine. And in the evenings, I spend time with loved ones.

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Why did you decide that?

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Exercise is key for me - it makes me feel connected to my body.

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: This is a great healthy habit!

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: It's like they say - "Can't pour from an empty cup." Looking out for ourselves gives us the energy to help others. And don't forget, you're worth it too!

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Thanks, Deb. Your words really mean something to me. I'll keep remembering to prioritize self-care.

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Hey Jolene, Anna got me a vegan stir-fry the other day - tofu and veg with ginger and soy sauce. It was really tasty! Food is such a wonderful source of pleasure and nourishment. What dishes are comforting to you?

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: One of my favorite dishes is lasagna! Comfort food can be a great pick-me-up. I've got a lot going on with my studies and exams.

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Have you been able to find time for yourself lately?

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: I've been trying to squeeze in some me-time. Last Friday, I did yoga and meditation to relax. Did you find time for yourself too? [shares a photo: a photo of a room with a wooden floor and a window]

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: I also did the same, it helped me reset my mind. How does it make you feel?

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: It's amazing how a few quiet moments can work wonders for the soul. [shares a photo: a photo of a purse with a plant on a table]

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Have you been able to get outside lately?

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: I did take Seraphim to the park last Sunday. She loved it and here's a pic. [shares a photo: a photo of a lizard laying on the ground surrounded by leaves]

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Looks like you guys had fun!

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: We explored new places. People are surprised when they see a tamed snake. What do you like about being outdoors?

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Hmm... The birds chirping and the breeze gently blowing! It reminds me of what really matters.

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Yep, it's like a reminder to slow down and appreciate the little things.

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Is there anything you want to be more mindful of right now?

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: I need to be more mindful of my stress levels and take care of my mental health. Sometimes I get too caught up in my studies and forget to prioritize self-care.

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Life can get hectic and it's easy to forget about ourselves.

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Exams and deadlines got me feeling overwhelmed. Just look at my to-do list! It seems never-ending... Trying my best but it's been challenging. [shares a photo: a photo of a desk with a notebook and a computer monitor]

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Your efforts will bear fruit, don't give up!

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Thanks, Deb. Any tips on studying or time management?

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: My tip is to break it into smaller pieces and set goals for yourself. For time management, planners or schedulers help you stay organized and give you time for yourself. Let me know if you need help with a study plan!

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: I appreciate your help with that.

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Take care and good luck with your exams. I'll give you a mug just like this one! It encourages. [shares a photo: a photo of a yellow coffee cup with a handwritten message]

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Thanks, Deb! This really cheered me up. All the best with your classes. Bye!

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Thanks, Jolene! Glad I could bring a smile to your face. Take care and make sure to give yourself some time to relax. Bye!

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Hi Jolene! We haven't corresponded for a long time!

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Hey Deb, yeah life can get chaotic. How's it been going lately?

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: So much has been going on lately. I started this yoga class in the neighborhood - it's such a good feeling! Now I get to share the exercise with my neighbors and watch it really transform them.

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Congrats. How did you do this?

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Thanks! My neighbors were interested in trying yoga, so I hosted a class for them on Friday. It was great to see everyone embrace and enjoy it. Here is our photo together. [shares a photo: a photo of a group of women posing for a picture]

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: That's cool! What made you want to start teaching it?

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: I find it calming and wanted to share that with others. Giving people peace and awareness brings me so much happiness.

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Wow, Deb! It's awesome when we can share something we love and make things better for others.

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Teaching it is awesome because it can help others and I've made such great friends through it. It's really nice for building community connections.

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: That's really motivating. It's great to have support in tough times.

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: It's one of life's best parts, right?

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Yeah, having someone to rely on is key in tough times. It really makes a difference in how we handle life. Plus, there's something I wanted to tell you.

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: What's up? I'm listening. We'll figure it out.

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: I'm having a hard time dealing with my Engineering assignments. It's a lot to manage and I'm struggling to keep up. Can we still talk about time management?

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Sure, Jolene. Let's find a time that works for both of us.

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Let's find a time to chat - I'll check my schedule and get back to you.

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Take your time, Jolene. We'll work it out. Take care of yourself, OK?

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: I'll make sure to take it. See you soon!

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: I'm here for you if you need me. Let's catch up soon.

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Have a great day!

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Hey Jolene, it's been a while. Hope you're doing okay with all your exams and deadlines. I know it's difficult for you right now.

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Hey Deb! Yeah, it can be tough. Trying to find time for everything is like playing catch-up - really stressful!

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: How do you manage your time and stay organized with all the projects and deadlines?

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: I'm using the Pomodoro Technique - 25 minutes work, 5-minute break - to avoid burnout but I'm still struggling to prioritize. Do you have any other tips on time management?

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: I create a daily schedule or to-do list. Here's my example for today. [shares a photo: a photo of a notepad with a list of things to do]

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: I tried making one but it's kinda overwhelming when it's a big stack of tasks. Here's an example from last Friday. [shares a photo: a photo of a notepad with notes on it on a counter]

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Have you tried breaking it down or prioritizing the tasks?

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: It can often feel overwhelming and difficult to figure out where to start.

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: I get it, Jolene. When I'm overloaded, I use a certain method. It helps me figure out what's important and urgent so I'm more organized. Do you know about it?

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Nah, I'm not familiar with that one. What's it about?

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Want me to tell you about it? It helps you organize things based on how important and urgent they are.

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Sure, tell me more about it! It sounds useful.

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: The Eisenhower Matrix sorts tasks into four boxes, categorizing them based on their urgency and importance. It can be really useful for organizing and prioritizing. Here's a breakdown.  [shares a photo: a photo of a pair of scissors sitting on top of a piece of paper]

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: The visualization is helpful too. Thanks for sharing!

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: I am glad, it was helpful. Let's give it a try and see if it helps you stay focused and less stressed.

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Yeah, I'll give it a go. Fingers crossed it'll help me. Thanks for the help!

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Don't forget to take it easy and look after yourself. Wishing you all the best! Recently, Anna and I were sitting by the sea, watching the sunset and talking about each other. And we realized that we inspire each other. What thoughts does the sea in this photo make you think of? [shares a photo: a photo of a person walking on the beach with a surfboard]

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: This gets me thinking of when I'll learn to surf. Gotta find that spare time!

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Surfing, huh Jolene? Chase your dreams, don't be daunted. Have you thought about the steps you can take?

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Definitely! I've been gathering information, watching videos, and I even got a beginners' guide to surfing. Just need to find the right time and place to get a lesson.

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Way to go! Taking those first steps is key. Believe in yourself and keep going! [shares a photo: a photo of a row of surfboards leaning against a palm tree]

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Thanks for the support! Those got me pumped to try surfing. Gonna keep pushing myself to make it happen.

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Keep it up, Jolene! Remember, the experience matters just as much as the end result. Step by step and have fun along the way. You can do it!

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Thanks for the boost!

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Hey Deb, long time no talk. A lot's happened! On Friday I had a breakthrough with my engineering project. Finally found a solution to a prob that's been bugging me. Feels great to see my hard work paying off. [shares a photo: a photo of a person's hand holding a pair of scissors]

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: You've really proven your skills. Feels great, right? Keep it up! And I bought new props for the yoga class! Here it is in action. [shares a photo: a photo of a group of people doing yoga in a room]

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Oh, I also have new details for this case! Rate it! [shares a photo: a photo of a cardboard mat with a cup of coffee on it]

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: That`s cool! I also bought this candle for the atmosphere and to improve my yoga practice. How about you? When you do it, what feelings do you get? [shares a photo: a photo of a candle with a sprig of rosemary on a table]

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: I feel relaxed during this activity. I love creating a serene space with soothing scents like lavender and rosemary. Do you have any favorite scents or rituals for when you do it?

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: I'm also a big fan of scents like this! Candles and essential oils add warmth and calm to my yoga session. It's amazing how certain smells can transport you to a place of peace.  Do you have any other ways to enhance your yoga practice?

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: I find music helps me. Any favorite tracks?

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: I find instrumental tracks with mellow melodies and rhythms help create a peaceful vibe. One of my favorites is a track called "Savana." What songs/artists do you like listening to during your practice?

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: I love listening to Nils Frahm and Olafur Arnalds during my practice. Their music is so calming and puts me in a different headspace. Do you have any recommendations for other similar artists or tracks I should check out?

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Also, I'm listening to an album called 'Sleep,' which is great for meditation and deep relaxation. Hope you find it as calming as I do!

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Thanks for the tips, Deborah! I'm gonna check them out. It's always good to have some new tunes for yoga!

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Let me know your thoughts on the albums!

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: See you!

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Take care and keep up the good work!

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Hey Jolene! Great to see you! Had a blast biking nearby with my neighbor last week - was so freeing and beautiful. Checked out an art show with a friend today - really cool and inspiring stuff. Reminded me of my mom. [shares a photo: a photo of a large brown and white photo of a person]

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Hey Deborah! Sounds like you had a blast biking and at the art show. Your photo looks like you were really into it! Did it make you think profound thoughts?

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: My mom was interested in art. She believed art could give out strong emotions and uniquely connect us. When I go to an art show, it's like we're still experiencing it together even though she's gone. It's hard but comforting.

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Losing someone is hard, but finding something that helps you cope is great.

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Finding ways to keep her memory alive gives me peace. It's amazing how something simple like artwork can bring back powerful emotions and remind us of those we've lost. It's about finding solace in the things we love, and art has done that for me.

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Even though my snakes can't chat or understand what I'm going through, our time together is valuable and teaches me to take time and be in tune with myself. Similarly, playing video games with my partner after a long day is a great way for me to relax.

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Simple things can indeed bring us the most happiness. How have these activities helped you during tough times?

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: It brings us closer together!

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: This kind of comfort can be really helpful when times get tough.

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Just so you know, I've been working on a big project lately - it's been tough but also really cool to watch it take shape. Can't wait to see the final result!

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: I am waiting to hear how everything turns out. Keep up the good work!

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Thanks Deb! Your support means a lot. I'll keep you updated on the progress of the project.

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Glad my support means a lot to you! I'll always be here for you.

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Take care!

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Enjoy your day and make time for the things that bring you joy. See ya!

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: I'll make sure to find time for that. Have a good one!

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Hey Deborah! Long time no talk - I had lots of stuff going on. Remember the tough engineering project? I finally wrapped that up last month. Look at the result! [shares a photo: a photo of a solar powered vehicle with a solar panel on the back]

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Jolene! Congrats on wrapping up your with it! You really put in the work and it paid off.

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: I'm really proud of myself for sticking it out despite the problems and finishing it. It's definitely a big milestone.

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Now that you've reached this big milestone, what do you have planned next?

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: I'm interning at a well-known engineering firm. It's been a great opportunity to test my skills and gain real-world experience. These are my new colleagues! [shares a photo: a photo of a group of construction workers posing for a picture]

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: What's been the best part of it so far?

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: The best part so far has been being able to apply what I learned in school to real projects. It's so fulfilling to see my ideas come to life.

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Mind if I ask how the internship has impacted you?

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: It has had a positive impact on my life. It has stoked my love of engineering and has encouraged me to keep striving for my dreams.

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: How has it inspired you to keep striving for your dreams?

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Hanging out with people who love what they do has really inspired me to stay focused and keep working towards my goals. It's shown me that with dedication and effort, anything is possible.

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Have you been able to find a good work-life balance during your internship?

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Honestly, finding that balance has been tough. I've been slogging away and it's been hard to make time for my hobbies and chilling out.

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Have you considered taking some breaks and finding activities like yoga to help you relax and unwind? That might make a difference.

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Yeah, I`m trying to do it. Here's an example of how I spent yesterday morning, yoga on top of mount Talkeetna. [shares a photo: a photo of a man standing on a rock with his arms outstretched]

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Nice job, Jolene! How long have you been doing yoga and meditation? It looks like it's really helping you regroup and recharge.

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: I've been doing them sporadically for about 3 years now and they've had a real positive effect on me.

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Has it benefited you in any way? Have you found it helpful in difficult moments?

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: It has helped me with stress and kept me centered.

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Glad they've been helpful for you!

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: No idea how I would've survived without them!

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: This is my favorite studio and it's always so calming.  [shares a photo: a photo of a room with a bench and a window]

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: I was wondering if you have any advice on calming the mind and breathing during yoga?

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: I'd recommend practicing mindful breathing for yoga. Set aside a few minutes each day to sit with your eyes closed, take deep breaths, and focus on how the air feels entering and leaving your body.

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Thanks, Deborah! I'll definitely give it a try. Appreciate the advice!

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: If you need more tips or help, just let me know. Take care!

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: See you!

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Hey Jolene! How's it going? We haven't talked in a while. I've been busy getting ready for a yoga retreat with some buddies. A chance to hang out with people who think like me and find peace and understanding. Sounds awesome! [shares a photo: a photo of a group of people doing yoga in a park]

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Hey Deb! Been super hectic with internship and stuff. That retreat sounds awesome, I could definitely use a break!

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: By the way, I tried a new pose - Dancer Pose (Natarajasana). Rate, did I succeed? [shares a photo: a photo of a woman doing a yoga pose on the beach]

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: You are amazing as always! Here are new photos of Seraphim in the new aquarium that I bought the day before yesterday. [shares a photo: a photo of a snake curled up in a plant filled area]

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Where'd you get it? I'm always drawn to animals, they bring so much joy. What's its story?

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: I got her last year, she's a great pet. She always cheers me up and brings a sense of peace. Spending time with her is so comforting.

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Pets really do make life more enjoyable and bright.  [shares a photo: a photo of a group of people doing yoga in a field]

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: I'm so thankful it's here. Plus, it's nice to have a calm creature around.

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: How have things been besides that?

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Things have been intense lately. I'm really pushing myself to succeed, and sometimes it feels overwhelming. But I'm determined to overcome any obstacles and achieve my goals.

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Keep up the hard work and remember to relax too.

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Thanks, Deborah! I had a big breakthrough with this project - so exciting and rewarding! [shares a photo: a photo of a drawing of a house with a ruler and a ruler]

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Awesome, Jolene! I'm really glad your project worked out.

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Stop talking about me, tell me more about your retreat.

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: I'd rather show you a photo. This is also a new yoga pose that we tried. It is a tree pose. [shares a photo: a photo of three people standing in front of a large statue]

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: What's that statue in the picture?

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: It's a symbol of peace and enlightenment.

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Wow, it looks gorgeous! I'd love to visit a retreat like that. It seems like the ideal spot to find peace and refreshment.

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: It's perfect for reflecting and getting centered.

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: I could really use some chill time like that. Sounds so peaceful.

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Yeah, we all need some peaceful time to relax.

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Gotta run, have a nice day!

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: See you! [shares a photo: a photo of a sunset reflecting in a lake with a boat]

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Hey Jolene! I started a running group with Anna - it's awesome connecting with people who care about fitness! [shares a photo: a photo of three men standing next to each other on a road]

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Cool, Deb! Glad you found some people to get fit with. I'm trying to add workouts into my studying schedule, which has been tough but fun. How about you? Any challenges with the running group?

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Oh, I'm having a blast with it! We help and push each other during our runs, which makes it so much easier to stay motivated.  I have a lot of my photos from this activity. [shares a photo: a photo of a woman standing on a sidewalk with a skateboard]

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Deborah, that's awesome! Being part of a supportive group must be super motivating. Finding a team that's passionate about something makes a huge difference. Just thinking about my own journey too.

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Having people who can cheer you on and give you advice really makes a difference. What has it been like for you finding supportive folks?

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Gaming's been tough lately, but I'm grateful I have someone who's also into it. My partner helps me stay focused on our goals. We have a lot of cute photos, I want to share with you. [shares a photo: a photo of a man and a woman sitting in a chair in front of a computer]

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: What do you like best about gaming together?

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: We get to tackle challenges and have a shared experience. It's always a blast when we're into the same game and achieve something tough. Plus, it's a great way to bond and get closer.

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Woah, that's cool! Gaming is so good for strengthening relationships. Do you two have a favorite game to play together?

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Yeah, we love playing "It takes two" together! It's a fun team-strategy game and it's competitive. Plus, it's a great way for us to bond. Do you have any activities you like doing with people?

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Yep, I do running and yoga/meditation with others. Connecting with people and creating a community is great. Plus, I love organizing workshops and events to practice mindfulness and self-care. It's an awesome way to have fun, build relationships, and support each other's growth. [shares a photo: a photo of a group of people doing yoga in a park]

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Sounds like a great way to relax. What do your workshops and events involve?

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: It involves various activities such as yoga, meditation, and self-reflection. They aim to cultivate self-awareness, promote mental and emotional well-being, and help individuals find inner peace. It's a space where people can connect, explore, and grow.

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Your events are awesome for helping people connect and learn, it is so important. How has everything been going for you?

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Thanks, Jolene! It's been great seeing everyone come together and support each other. It's amazing to witness the growth and transformation that happens through these workshops. I'm honored to be a part of it. [shares a photo: a photo of a game board with a bunch of cards on it]

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Wow, Deb! I can imagine how rewarding it must be to create a space for growth and change. It's great to hear that everything's going well. You can always count on me for support! I just want to share a photo with you. [shares a photo: a photo of a snake on a branch with a book]

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Thanks, Jolene! Your support means a lot to me. I'm here for you too. By the way, I noticed your pet in the picture. What made you decide to get a snake?

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: I was fascinated by reptiles, and it felt like the perfect pet for me. Taking care of it has been really calming, and it's a great way to connect with nature.

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Glad you found something that gives you peace and calm. Do you have a favorite memory with "it" to share?

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: I have lots of great memories, like our little 'snake adventure'. She got out and I spent hours searching, so relieved when I finally found her snuggling under the bed. It really showed how much I love her. [shares a photo: a photo of a snake in a tank with sand and plants]

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: What was it like when you found her? I can imagine the relief!

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Seeing her snuggled under the bed made me feel so much love and gratitude. It made me realize how important she is to me.

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: They bring so much joy and remind us of what's important.

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Animals teach us a lot about love and gratitude, and they bring so much joy.

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: I haven't introduced you to my pets yet! I don't like dogs, that's why I have cats. [shares a photo: a photography of two cats sitting on a couch with a blanket]

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Looks like they're having a blast! How often do you take them out?

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Exercise and nature are really important to me, so I make sure to take them out for a run in the park every morning and evening. [shares a photo: a photo of a person walking on the beach with a surfboard]

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Wow Deb, that's great! I'd love to experience that every day.

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Nature helps me find peace every day - it's so refreshing!

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: It's a pity that my snakes don't run!  I'd love to do that more often. They would motivate me and together it would be more fun. [shares a photo: a photo of a person walking on the beach with a surfboard]

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: It's like hitting a reset button that helps me put things into perspective and gives me time to reflect.

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: Yeah, I totally get it. Whenever I can, I love going for walks to take it all in. And I take photos like this [shares a photo: a photo of a sunset over a body of water]

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: It's amazing how nature has the power to bring us peace and clarity.

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: This photo captures the peacefulness of a lake surrounded by trees. [shares a photo: a photo of a dock on a lake with trees in the background]

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Why did you choose that spot? It looks so calm.

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: It's such a hidden gem! It makes me feel so peaceful and tranquil.

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: Lucky you for having somewhere to relax and tune out!

turns.speaker: Jolene
turns.text: We'll definitely go there together sometime!

turns.speaker: Deborah
turns.text: We all need a timeout!
